errors.text_span: with tick marks at each integer value
errors.evidence: The x-axis tick marks are not at each integer; they are shown at intervals of 2 (1, 3, 5, 7, etc.).
The blue line begins at an accuracy value closer to 0.72, making 0.8 a significant overestimation.
The blue line does not decline at the end of the x-axis. It rises from a value of approximately 0.9 at x=13 to 1.0 at x=15 and ends at a value of 1.0 at x=19, not 0.9.
For the green line, the value at x=13 is approximately 0.6, not 0.5.
The green line does not end at an accuracy of 0.5. It increases sharply from x=15 to reach an accuracy of 1.0 at x=17, and then ends at 1.0 at x=19.
